How the two-stage search works

First: compare unique words for one added, removed, replaced or moved letter, capitalization, or diacritic change. We also look for your words in the starter collection.

Then: review dictionary definitions and choose the relevant senses. New pairs begin at 1/5, provisional. Familiarity and semantic points require your review; spelling alone cannot establish opposition. Scores are editorial judgments, not automatic semantic facts.

A move relocates one letter. Spacing and punctuation are planned; this version compares individual words. Scans support up to 1,500 unique words per drop.
